items.quote: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel
items.claim: Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel on the eighth day
items.object: Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel

items.quote: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD
items.claim: Moses commanded Aaron to take a young calf and a ram without blemish and to offer them before the LORD
